audience: Mike, Fadi, and Joel reviewing Aureon native GPU benchmark results
claim: Controlled Metal function-mode changes reduce resident time while full validation remains intact; exact CPU parallel validation cuts checking time.

metric.name: Elapsed time
metric.aggregation: median with every raw trial visible

uncertainty.note: Raw repeat spread; no confidence interval or claim of universal ranking. Validation confirmation observations linked within pairs.

data_source.notes: Every dataset checksum captured in figure-specific evidence JSON. Historical browser timing is omitted from these controlled comparison figures because its output layout and validation cadence differ.

cost_latency_assumptions.statistic: Median of ten measured repeats per controlled Metal variant; median of ten paired validator repetitions
cost_latency_assumptions.other: Native SoA input and packed XYZ output, 2.4 GB requested GPU buffers. All 300M coordinates fully checked.

exceptions: Companion validation plot uses connected paired points to preserve AB/BA pair structure.
1600x1000 sharing PNG plus 3200x2000 high-density PNG supplied; SVG remains editable.
Three separate figures preserve clear timing boundaries and readable labels; integrated measurement includes validation while resident GPU time excludes it.
